song.title: Gather in Your Light

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.primary:
We come with open hands today
We leave our hurried thoughts behind
Your kindness meets us on the way
Your welcome gives our hearts a home

sections.label: Chorus
sections.primary:
We gather in Your light
We lift one song of praise
Together in Your love
We walk in hope and grace

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.primary:
Be near to every weary heart
Give strength to those who feel alone
Teach us to serve with willing hands
And make Your mercy daily known
